scenarios.title: 1. Review button disabled if no PR URL and no diff
scenarios.purpose: Ensure the Analyze change button is disabled when there is no pull request URL and no diff, even if API is not ready.

scenarios.title: 2. Review button disabled if no PR URL with diff present
scenarios.purpose: Check that Analyze change button remains disabled if pull request URL is empty even if diff text is present, before patch removes this restriction.

scenarios.title: 3. Review button disabled if API not ready
scenarios.purpose: Verify Analyze change button is disabled when API status is not ready (false), indicating setup required state.

scenarios.title: 4. Setup required message and buttons disabled with missing API keys
scenarios.purpose: Confirm that the setup required pill is shown, the inline setup hint message is present, and key buttons are disabled when API keys are not configured.

steps.expected: Configure OPENAI_API_KEY and DATABASE_URL to enable reviews. See the setup guide.

scenarios.title: 5. Load example diff button populates diff containing 'Invoice not found' text
scenarios.purpose: Verify the Load example diff button loads the sample diff text with string 'Invoice not found' present in the diff text area.
